 Very warm Thursday 
 A warm front is bringing warmer temperatures this afternoon and on Thursday. By Kris Hudson Published : Oct. 28, 2026 at 2:27 PM EDT | Updated : 5 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WATERTOWN, New York (WWNY) - Temperatures are warming up this afternoon as a warm front is moving through. 
 Highs on Thursday will top out around 70, with breezy conditions expected throughout the day. Rain showers will move in by the evening and overnight hours Thursday as a cold front moves through. 
 Friday highs will remain in the 50s with a cool northern wind. 
 Halloween highs look to stay in the upper 40s to around 50 with plenty of sunshine. 
 7News Meteorologist Kris Hudson has the latest forecast.
